subject: submit_cran Lead to Old Versions of Vignettes on CRAN

messages.author: 196f803c4380d741
messages.subject: submit_cran Lead to Old Versions of Vignettes on CRAN
parts:
Hi,

I recently made my first submission to CRAN and I was surprised to find that the vignettes up on CRAN are not in sync with the vignettes in my repo. 

Is it necessary to run devtools::build_vignettes before using devtools::release / devtools::submit_cran? The vignettes that show up on CRAN are the versions leftover in /inst/docs/ from the last time I tested them through build_vignettes (or maybe devtools::install, I'm not certain which way I did it last), but there are more recent versions in /vignettes/ that seem to have been ignored. 

I read through the "CRAN notes" troubleshooting in Hadley's R Packages, but none of the tips applied. Here's my session info:

messages.subject: Re: submit_cran Lead to Old Versions of Vignettes on CRAN
parts:
I did some experimenting and it appears that "R CMD build --no-resave-data --no-manual" (the default for source packages via devtools::build) will not build vignettes (or at least won't save them) if files already exist in inst/doc/ matching the names of the vignette's outputs. However,  it still displays the status messages "* installing the package to build vignettes" and "* creating vignettes ... OK" as if it did. 

This makes devtools::build_vignettes a bit dangerous as it will leave those files in inst/doc/ silently preventing future builds from updating the built vignettes (the files also to not present git status due to devtools conveniently adding /inst/docs/ to .gitignore)

I tried using .Rbuildignore to exclude inst/docs/, but I ended up with no inst/docs/ in the tarball, presumably the action to exclude ignore files is performed after the building of vignettes

In the end, deleting the vignette files from /inst/docs/ restored proper building functionality.  

And, of course, ?build_vignettes, provides cautions against this very mistake. I guess I should have started there.
